summary: Inspected projects/PadicLFunctions/PadicLFunctions/PadicExp.lean (63935 bytes). This file contains substantial formal mathematical content: definitions of p-adic exponential (padicExp) and logarithm (padicLog), convergence proofs using Legendre's formula, isometry properties on the open ball ‖x‖ < p^{−1/(p−1)}, functional equations (exp(x+y)=exp(x)exp(y)), inversion theorems (exp(log(1+x))=1+x, log(exp(x)−1)=x) via formal power series composition and ultrametric Fubini, restriction to pℤ_p for odd p with integrality certificates, and the final RJW Lemma 5.14 statement that x^s := exp(s·log x) agrees with the character construction PadicInt.onePAdicPow. All content is definition, statement, or proof — no part is pure import, documentation, or generated boilerplate. The prior review of 17 PadicLFunctions files retained all; this file is of the same kind and must stay searchable.
